text:
Palladium Price in 2004
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2004, the LBMA palladium price fell 20.0% between 2004-01-30 ($230) and 2004-12-30 ($184). The highest sampled price was $285 in March and the lowest was $184 in December. The mean of these observations was $226. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
